actual_scope: Exhaust every legal whole-helper relocation with unchanged idle histogram, followed by one strictly improving relocation, on the selected PR1094 map. Fixed widths, calls, source-event windows and original child bins; repack each affected occupied prefix.
scope_change_reason: PR1343 excludes improving single relocations and PR1407 already constructs neutral paths. This adds an exact two-move census and exponent-uniform profile comparison, not priority for neutral-path constructions.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds. These moves change only its idle histogram; local supplier and bit charges stay fixed. The result bounds one named neighborhood and does not claim a new global frontier.
stop_rule: One complete two-move census with integer comparison and bounded controls; stop if the implementation cannot complete in 10 minutes or remaining verification budget falls below 15 minutes.

All 156 intermediate/final owner maps pass the retained owner auditor. crosscheck.py exhausts every post-prefix rank-class product. test_verify.py checks a complete small domain and deliberate failures.
